list_of_rare_earth_compounds.formula: C52 H69 Cl2 Gd4 N5 O2 Si4,C4 H8 O1

properties.summary: The Gd4 cluster is described as strongly paramagnetic; its effective magnetic moment is reported as 8.0 μB. The strong paramagnetism made the 1H NMR spectrum uninformative.

source_locations.location: Summary; structural formula after the introductory paragraph
Figure 1 caption; X-ray diffraction studies paragraph

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A tetranuclear butterfly arrangement of four Gd centers is connected by four doubly bridging μ2-NHSiMe2(indenyl) units along the metal–metal edges, two triply bridging μ3-Cl atoms, and a central quadruply bridging μ4-NH group on a crystallographic twofold axis. Each Gd has a distorted-octahedral environment with formal coordination number 8; indenyl ligation is η5, and the Ln(1)/Ln(1A) sites additionally bind THF. The cluster is isostructural and isomorphous with the Er analogue.

synthesis.procedure: The silicon/indenyl/carborane precursor Me2Si(C9H7)(C2B10H11) was treated with 4 equiv of NaNH2 in dry THF at room temperature, followed by reaction with 1 equiv of GdCl3. After workup, colorless crystals of cluster 1 were obtained.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After workup, colorless crystals were obtained.
